parsed_json.up: Select the ChEMBL identifier and canonical SMILES for distinct compounds tested against human Cytochrome P450 2D6 (CHEMBL289). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then assays, then target_dictionary, filtering by target ChEMBL ID. Join compound_structures to retrieve canonical SMILES. Return columns compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id.
